ruling: Captain-authorised 2026-08-09: 'let's focus on the 62. remove from activated-, create new axis if need be.' These members sit on an axis whose DELIVERY head their ability does not have — verified by reading: Frostfist Strider, Summon: Shiva, Nazahn and Dungeon Geists are on rule:activated-* and NONE has an activated ability (CR 602.1 '[Cost]: [Effect]'); their effect arrives by ETB, attack trigger or Saga chapter (CR 113.3c / 714.2). Record: docs/WIDE-TRIAGE-2026-08-09.md. EXCLUDED 53d58401 (Codespell Cleric) from rule:cast-trigger-plus1-counter: definition_drift C1b caught it — its evidence quote is a TOKEN ('create a 0/3 white Wall creature token'), not a counter, so it does not belong on a -plus1-counter axis under §8 rule 3. That membership was ALREADY wrong on its source axis; the move would have propagated the defect into a NEW axis. Left in place as a pre-existing tracked finding.
